Title: Accept module layer knowledge
Description: As a backend engineer, I want to accept module-level and layer-level knowledge items from the desktop so that the system understands architectural layers. The upload validation accepts unit_kind=module and kind=layer with folder file_path. Ingestion maps them to chunks with provenance at folder level.
AcceptanceCriteria: Collector server POST /collector/batches/knowledge validation accepts unit_kind=module
Validation accepts kind=layer for architectural layer knowledge
Layer items must have a folder file_path, not a specific file
Chunks are created with provenance.file_path pointing to the folder
provenance_maps rows for layer items carry the folder file_path and a line_range filled per the US122 shape rules
Provenance.section_hint is not used for layer items
Layer items are treated as document-level knowledge, not unit-level
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Extending the knowledge batch upload to accept module-level and layer-level knowledge items with folder-level provenance. Backend ingestion stores these as chunks with architectural scope.
